## What it is

16×16 pixel baffle, the same 162.4 × 162.4 × 8.5 mm insert as `enclosures/matrix_16x16_mount`. Either print drops into this housing.

## Design notes

- 1.2 mm divider walls (three perimeters at a 0.4 mm nozzle) and 8.8 mm cell openings over each 5050 LED.
- 0.3 mm per side in the housing's 163 mm track. The top edge carries a 0.8 mm chamfer; the bed face does not.

## Don't

- Don't thicken the divider walls enough to shadow the 5 mm LED package. The cell opening has to stay above 6 mm.
- Don't chamfer the bed face.
